summary: Pilgrim's Pride, via subsidiary Onix Investments UK Limited, signed a Share Purchase Agreement on 2026-08-14 to acquire Walker's Deli Sausage Company from Samworth Brothers Limited. Total consideration is approximately £141.5 million on a debt-free, cash-free basis, paid fully in cash at closing. Closing expected September 2026, subject to UK CMA approval and employee consultation. No financing condition; includes customary warranties, indemnities, termination rights. Risk-arb angle: monitor regulatory clearance and consultation timeline; deal is small relative to Pilgrim's Pride, likely low execution risk.
